feature: Implement Consistent Empty State UI Pattern
description: Create a reusable EmptyState component with consistent styling and actionable CTAs. Currently empty states are implemented ad-hoc with varying styles across PluginsScreen, SearchScreen, HomeScreen, LibraryScreen, DownloadsScreen, CalendarScreen, and AddonsScreen.

phases.name: Create EmptyState Component
phases.description: Build a flexible, reusable EmptyState component following existing patterns

subtasks.title: Create EmptyState component with flexible props
subtasks.description: Create src/components/common/EmptyState.tsx with props for icon (name, size, library), title, subtitle, CTA button (label, onPress), and optional secondary action. Use theme colors and follow LoadingSpinner patterns. Support MaterialIcons, Ionicons, and MaterialCommunityIcons. Add tablet responsiveness.
subtasks.notes: Created EmptyState.tsx with support for MaterialIcons, Ionicons, and MaterialCommunityIcons. Component includes icon config (name, size, library), title, optional subtitle, primary and secondary actions, tablet responsiveness, and theme-aware colors.

subtasks.title: Create index barrel export for common components
subtasks.description: Create or update src/components/common/index.ts to export all common components including the new EmptyState for cleaner imports
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/common/index.ts barrel export file with exports for all common components: AgeRatingBadge, DogLoadingSpinner, EmptyState, LoadingSpinner, OptimizedImage, ScreenHeader, TraktLoadingSpinner, and the AgeRating type.

phases.name: Integrate EmptyState into Key Screens
phases.description: Replace ad-hoc empty states with the new reusable component in key screens

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in SearchScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the two inline empty state implementations in SearchScreen with EmptyState component for both 'Keep typing' and 'No results found' states
subtasks.notes: Replaced both inline empty state implementations in SearchScreen with EmptyState component: (1) 'Keep typing...' state with search icon, (2) 'No results found' state with search-off icon. Both use MaterialIcons library.

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in LibraryScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the three inline empty state implementations in LibraryScreen with EmptyState component for Trakt collections, empty library, and filtered states
subtasks.notes: Replaced three inline empty state implementations in LibraryScreen with EmptyState component: (1) Trakt collections empty state with 'folder-off-outline' icon from MaterialCommunityIcons, (2) Empty Trakt folder content state with 'folder-open-outline' icon from MaterialCommunityIcons, (3) Empty library state with 'video-library' icon from MaterialIcons. All states now use consistent styling via the EmptyState component.

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in PluginsScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the inline empty state implementation in PluginsScreen with EmptyState component for when no scrapers are available
subtasks.notes: Replaced inline empty state implementation in PluginsScreen with EmptyState component. Handles two scenarios: (1) 'No Scrapers Found' when searchQuery has a value but no matching results (uses search icon from Ionicons with "Clear Search" action), (2) 'No Scrapers Available' when filteredScrapers.length === 0 and no search query (uses download-outline icon from Ionicons). Added custom style prop to adjust layout for the collapsible section context.

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in DownloadsScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the EmptyDownloadsState component and emptyFilterContainer with unified EmptyState component
subtasks.notes: Replaced EmptyDownloadsState component and emptyFilterContainer in ListEmptyComponent with unified EmptyState component. Main empty state uses MaterialCommunityIcons 'download-outline' icon with 'Explore Content' action. Filter empty state uses MaterialCommunityIcons 'filter-off' icon (size 48) with custom emptyFilterState style. Removed 8 unused inline empty state styles.

phases.name: Integrate EmptyState in Additional Screens
phases.description: Continue integration in remaining screens that have empty states

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in CalendarScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the inline empty state implementation in CalendarScreen with EmptyState component
subtasks.notes: Replaced two inline empty state implementations in CalendarScreen with EmptyState component: (1) Filter empty state when no episodes for selected date uses 'event-busy' icon (size 48) from MaterialIcons with 'Show All Episodes' action, (2) Main empty state when calendarData.length === 0 uses 'calendar-today' icon from MaterialIcons with subtitle text.

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in HomeScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the inline 'No content available' empty state in HomeScreen with EmptyState component
subtasks.notes: Replaced inline 'No content available' empty state in HomeScreen ListFooterComponent with EmptyState component. Uses 'movie-filter' icon from MaterialIcons (size 48), title 'No content available', subtitle 'Add catalogs to see your content here', and primary action 'Add Catalogs' navigating to Settings. Added emptyCatalogState style for compact layout in list footer context.

subtasks.title: Integrate EmptyState in AddonsScreen
subtasks.description: Replace the inline empty state implementations in AddonsScreen with EmptyState component
subtasks.notes: Replaced three inline empty state implementations in AddonsScreen with EmptyState component: (1) Installed addons empty state when addons.length === 0 uses 'extension-off' icon (size 48) from MaterialCommunityIcons with subtitle, (2) Community addons error state when communityError is set uses 'error-outline' icon from MaterialIcons with 'Retry' action calling loadCommunityAddons, (3) Community addons empty state when communityAddons.length === 0 uses 'extension-off' icon from MaterialCommunityIcons with subtitle. Added sectionEmptyState style (flex: 0, paddingVertical: 32) for compact layout in section contexts.

phases.name: Cleanup and Verification
phases.description: Remove unused styles and verify build

subtasks.title: Remove unused empty state styles from screens
subtasks.description: Clean up leftover emptyContainer, emptyText, emptySubtext, exploreButton styles from screens that now use the EmptyState component
subtasks.notes: Removed unused empty state styles from 5 screens that now use the EmptyState component: SearchScreen.tsx (emptyContainer, emptyText, emptySubtext), LibraryScreen.tsx (emptyContainer, emptyText, emptySubtext, exploreButton, exploreButtonText), PluginsScreen.tsx (emptyContainer, emptyText), AddonsScreen.tsx (emptyContainer, emptyText), CalendarScreen.tsx (emptyContainer, emptyText, emptySubtext). Total 102 lines of dead code removed.

subtasks.title: Verify TypeScript and build
subtasks.description: Run TypeScript compilation and verify no type errors. Run the build to ensure everything compiles correctly.
subtasks.notes: Manual TypeScript verification completed successfully. Since tsc is not available in this sandboxed environment, performed thorough manual code review: (1) EmptyState component has proper TypeScript interfaces - IconLibrary type, IconConfig, ActionConfig, EmptyStateProps, (2) Type assertions for icon names correctly use 'as keyof typeof X.glyphMap' pattern, (3) All 7 screens correctly import from barrel export and use proper prop types, (4) 14 total EmptyState usages verified - all match interface contract, (5) No syntax errors or obvious type issues detected. Build verification deferred to CI/CD pipeline.

final_acceptance: EmptyState component exists with consistent styling
technical_notes: Existing empty states use varying icon sizes (48-80px) - standardize to 64px default with size prop
CTA buttons use different border-radius values - standardize to 24px rounded buttons
Some screens use hardcoded colors - all should use currentTheme.colors
Tablet responsiveness varies - use Dimensions.get('window').width >= 768 pattern consistently
Follow LoadingSpinner pattern for component structure and props interface
The EmptyState component should support: icon (name, library), title, subtitle, primaryAction (label, onPress), secondaryAction (optional)
Icon libraries to support: MaterialIcons, Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons
